meta.title: The Emperor's New Clothes
meta.author: Hans Christian Andersen
meta.blurb: Two swindlers promise an emperor cloth so fine that it is invisible to anyone stupid or unfit for office. Nobody wants to be either, so nobody says what they see.
meta.mood: A court that cannot say what it sees

segments.text: Time passed merrily in the large town which was his capital; strangers arrived every day at the court. One day, two rogues, calling themselves weavers, made their appearance. They gave out that they knew how to weave stuffs of the most beautiful colors and elaborate patterns, the clothes manufactured from which should have the wonderful property of remaining invisible to everyone who was unfit for the office he held, or who was extraordinarily simple in character.
